messages:
incident-bot: TABLETOP DRILL: Simulated SEV2 in ap-southeast-1 — autoscaler misconfiguration causes burst queueing and elevated latency on /v1/chat. This is a drill; treat communications as real.

sam: ack. I'll run incident command and own comms. calling it now.

leila: acked. i'll craft status page + customer SMS template.

owen: i'm on diagnostics. will pull simulated pod metrics and confirm which autoscaler group triggered.

nisha: taking secondary oncall. will assist with runbook steps and handoff checklist.

sam: objective 1: practice fast public-facing status update. keep it tight. pretend it's 2026-03-15T22:00:00Z. leila, can you post a concise status and also draft a one-line SMS for customers?

leila: status page draft (copy to status.redwood.ai when we confirm):

```
Status: Investigating
Impact: Some customers in ap-southeast-1 may experience elevated latency and intermittent failures on chat/generate endpoints.
Started: 2026-03-15T22:00:00Z (drill)
Next update: in 10 minutes or on material change
Notes: Our on-call team is diagnosing autoscaler behavior; no confirmed data loss.
```

leila: SMS draft for high-touch customers (keeps within 160 chars):

"Redwood: Weare investigating elevated latency in ap-southeast-1 affecting chat. No data loss. Status page: status.redwood.ai (drill)"

support-bot: Reminder: for SMS and urgent emails, use the internal-test-cust-list for drills. Do not contact production customers.

owen: pulled sim metrics: autoscaler group autoscale-chat-aps1 entered cooldown loop; queue_depth per pod rose to 25; p95 1.9s -> 3.6s. errors up slightly (0.4%). snippet:

```
host-a1: queue_depth=25, cpu=92%, restart_count=0
host-a3: queue_depth=21, cpu=88%, restart_count=0
p95_before=190ms p95_during=3600ms
```

sam: that maps to runbook section "autoscaler cooldown -> queueing". primary mitigation for drill: force-scale chat pool + temporarily reroute small-percentage of traffic to us-east-1. nisha, simulate force-scale cadence and confirm metric effect.

nisha: sim action: force-scaled chat pool from 8 -> 24 pods; introduced 10% cross-region routing for eligible workloads. new sim metrics in ~6m.

eng-runbooks-bot: Runbook step invoked: autoscaler_cooldown_mitigation v2.1. Commands:
```
kubectl scale deploy/chat-inference --replicas=24 -n inference-prod-aps1
# verify: watch -n 5 kubectl get pods -l app=chat-inference -n inference-prod-aps1
```

leila: customer email draft for impacted list (short, friendly):

"Subject: Redwood: Brief latency interruption in ap-southeast-1 (drill)

Hi <name>,

We're running a simulated incident exercising our response to elevated latency in ap-southeast-1. During this drill some requests to chat/generate endpoints may be slower or intermittently fail. There is no data loss.

Suggested temporary mitigation: routing requests to us-east-1 reduces latency for many customers; contact support for help switching.

We'll follow up with a summary when the drill concludes.

Redwood Reliability"

sam: internal comms blurb for CS/Sales/legal (short):

"Heads-up (drill): executing latency drill in ap-southeast-1. Some customers may see degraded chat latency/few errors. No data loss. If you get inbound, please reference internal-test guidance or DM @leila. Do not engage customers directly unless cleared. (drill)"

leila: added note for legal/compliance: "drill only; no customer data access; do not escalate to region regulators."

owen: sim results: after force-scale + 10% routing, p95 reduced to ~240ms and queue_depth down to 4. errors returned to baseline.

nisha: preparing handoff at T+20m. sam, write the 3-line summary you'll hand to the next oncall. include what was done and remaining action items.

sam: 3-line handoff draft:

"Status: Resolved (drill): Elevated chat latency in ap-southeast-1 caused by autoscaler cooldown loop; current p95 ~240ms, error rate back to baseline.
Actions taken: Forced scale chat pool (8->24), enabled 10% cross-region routing to us-east-1 for eligible requests.
Next steps: Update autoscaler config to prevent cooldown loop, add automated remediation to runbook, and validate cross-region routing playbooks. Next update: post-drill report"

eng-runbooks-bot: Action item created: PROJ-5647 update autoscaler runbook with exact kubectl commands, expected metrics, and rollback steps. Owner: ow
en. Priority: P2.

leila: post-drill retrospective: quick feedback thread here. My notes: status page ok but include "affected features" tag (chat/generation) and recommended contact channel (support/test). For SMS, maybe shorten further and include tiny link.

ownen: ops feedback: we need pre-approved language for cross-region routing advice so CS doesn't have to seek legal each time. Also add a checklist item: "confirm customers have access to target region before suggesting region switch."

nisha: oncall ergonomics: handoff template needs a line for "ongoing mitigations with commands executed" so the next oncall doesn't repeat steps. also log the exact simulation IDs used in drills.

sam: agreed. action items: leila will update comms templates to include affected features and contact shortcodes; owen will update runbook with command snippets and monitoring expectations; nisha will add handoff template fields. i'll schedule a 30m follow-up retro to finalize changes.

incident-bot: DRILL COMPLETE: Post-drill report link (internal): https://intranet.redwood.ai/drills/20260315-autoscaler-aps1 (drill)

support-bot: Customer messages queued to internal-test-cust-list (drill). No production outreach performed.

sam: thanks everyone. solid dry run. please drop any stray notes here and i'll convert to tickets. :raised_hands:
